notes:
Summary: Closed-lost. Customer chose AWS managed endpoints (SageMaker/Model Endpoints) over Redwood Dedicated/Private. Primary reasons: existing heavy AWS commitment, single-billing convenience, and internal security team prioritized native cloud provider path.

Key points from process:
- Initial interest (Aug 2025): wanted to reduce per-call latency for chat support bot and improve document reranking for search. L4 trade desk wanted embeddings for similarity searches.
- Discovery: strong engineering buy-in; ops liked Redwood's batching + caching proposals. Procurement flagged budget cadence (FY26 Q1 freeze).
- Tech deep dive (Oct 2025): SE workshop with Priya; ran mini POC on hosted_api; latency numbers looked good (p95 ~120ms on currency-limited tests).
- Security review (Nov 2025-Dec 2025): strandhaven sec team asked for KMS/HSM integration, provable audit trail, and cloud-residency guarantees. They issued security questionnaire and a short RFP.
- Cost model review (Dec 2025): finance ran TCO vs AWS endpoints. Hyperscaler won due to reserved discounts + existing commitment to EKS+SageMaker.
- Momentum loss (Jan 2026): main internal champion (Head of Platform) left; no one stepped up to drive procurement. Combined with budget freeze, deal stalled.
- Final decision (Feb 2026): procurement selected AWS managed endpoints — cited "one-vendor cloud stack" and simplified compliance path.

Direct quote (from Head of Procurement): "Vendor consolidation wins here — we can't add new billing/entitlement silos this quarter."

Follow-ups attempted: 3 outreach emails, 1 final call (01-29-2026) to capture closure reason and request security doc sign-off. No appetite to reopen until next fiscal planning cycle.

Internals/lessons:
- Need clearer KMS/HSM positioning and a marketplace/billing story for AWS/GCP marketplaces to counter consolidation argument.
- Capture concise one-pager comparing Redwood Dedicated vs hyperscaler endpoints for security/compliance.
- Sales playbook: add explicit cadence for accounts with high cloud commitment + common procurement freeze months.
